subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for the open cross-repo fix PR to become mergeable, or replace it with a maintainer-owned narrow PR?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is conflicting and cannot be edited by maintainers.

options.title: Replace the cross-repo PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow same-repository replacement, credit the source work, and close the cross-repo PR after the replacement exists.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the open cross-repo PR and ask the contributor to rebase it and enable maintainer edits if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave this issue and the cross-repo PR open, accepting that the source-reproducible rendering bug remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Replace the cross-repo PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow same-repository replacement, credit the source work, and close the cross-repo PR after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original shared sanitizer path and authored the TUI leading-stripper follow-up, making them the strongest routing candidate for the UI/TUI boundary decision.
